ratios.quote: GCI, LLC’s first lien leverage ratio may not exceed 4.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: Only the covenant limit is disclosed; the excerpt gives no actual first lien leverage ratio. The covenant applies to GCI, LLC, the borrowing subsidiary under the Senior Credit Facility (Ninth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement). The total leverage and secured leverage ratios mentioned elsewhere only set interest margins, commitment fees and amortization step-ups, so they are excluded.
